# Test fonts

The latin subsets of [Gochi Hand](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Gochi+Hand), [Patrick Hand](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Patrick+Hand), [Nunito](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Nunito) and [Titan One](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Titan+One), as Google Fonts serves them. All four are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The browser tests serve them in place of Google Fonts so layout checks measure the real fonts offline.
